about.overview: SkinWorks is a Christchurch Beauty Clinic & the first in New Zealand to offer technologically advanced and non-invasive treatments in a relaxing environment that really work

before.title: Christchurch Beauty Clinic: Modern Non-Invasive Skin Treatments & Day Spa

issues.title: Not mobile-friendly
issues.evidence: The page has no responsive viewport tag, so phones show a shrunken desktop layout.

issues.title: Not served over HTTPS
issues.evidence: Final URL is http://www.skinworks.co.nz/. Browsers label this site "Not secure".

issues.title: Built with legacy page techniques
issues.evidence: 4 deprecated tags and 8 layout tables found (modern sites use responsive CSS).

issues.title: No easy way to get in touch
issues.evidence: No tap-to-call link and no enquiry form on the homepage.

issues.title: Images missing descriptions
issues.evidence: 18 of 18 images have no alt text (accessibility and SEO).

issues.title: No local-business search markup
issues.evidence: No structured data, so Google has less to show for the business.
